text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: "Miss Pace Blind" isn't writing back…

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
They ripped off all your sticky notes. That's so mean! 
…I guess they really are bad guys.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
So writing on the wall to them didn't work… Dang. 
I figured we could get this figured out if they just replied to 
Urara-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Maybe they're being careful. 
People are spreading rumors that the Disciplinary Committee 
might be cracking down.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: And Windy-san… Your cunning and villainous mind let you think on your feet! You can see so many possibilities that I never could!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
If we want the bad guys to make a move, 
we need to think like bad guys.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
So I'm gonna think of the perfect plan to make 
'em wanna show themselves! 
Hehehe, hope you're ready, bad guys!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Did you come up with something, Windy-senpai!? 
All right, I'll help!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Me next! So, can I write to Miss Pace Blind again then?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I feel like she wanted to tell me something. 
So I wanna keep at it until we can talk!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! If we keep trying, she's gotta write back 
eventually! Let's write a new reply together!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Hmm… When we found out they were coming here because 
they lost, you felt like you had to do something, right? 
So show her how you feel!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
I'll help think of ways to get your feelings across! 
Let's do our best and get this done, Urara-chan!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Mmhmm! I wanna tell her everything I feel! 
Thanks for helping me, Big-san!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Okayyyy! Here I go! 
Umm… "When I race with front runners"…

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Whaaat!? Are you seriously gonna do that!?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
It'll be okay, promise! 
I know all about how bad guys think. 'Cuz I'm a bad guy too!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah… You're right. 
You're the baddest bad guy I know.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Even Fenomeno had high hopes for my badness! 
I guess… I guess she has pretty good taste, huh!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, she sure does. She really appreciated us, and treated us 
like she needed us. So we're gonna return the favor!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Muhahaha! I don't wanna brag, this is a perfect plan ♪ 
Now I just need to pop into their hideout in the billiard room…

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Windy-san.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Eek! 
C-C-C-Captain!?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I'm not your captain anymore, remember? 
Though… I may be mistaken, but did I hear you mention 
going to the billiard room?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
N-no you didn't! I totally didn't say that! 
I don't even care about the investigation anymore! Nope!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I see. 
……Oh. Would you mind waiting here for a moment?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Here. 
I believe this will fit you perfectly.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Okay, senpai, it's up to you now! 
Show 'em what being a bad guy's all about!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me! 
I've got this sick outfit Captain gave me, so they're gonna 
know I mean business!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: If you've been sneaking into the archive room, then listen up!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
From now on the archive belongs to WINDY-CHAN! 
I've planted a whooooole buncha traps! So you'd better think 
twice about sneaking in if you don't wanna get got ♪

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: If you really wanna use that room, then come to the archive this weekend! Tell all your buddies who aren't here today, too!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume from the Result Sheet
text_block_list.text: Excuse me? Ohh… You're with that Disciplinary Committee narc who was sniffing around the other day, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat? What kind of Disciplinary Committee member 
would lay a trap? …Oh, sorry, I get it now! 
You're just making up an excuse 'cuz you're scared!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Are you seriously chickening out? Ha ha, chicken, chicken! 
You losers are all just a bunch of fake bad guys!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
If you really think you're bad, then you'll have to break into the 
archive and prove it!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: 'Cuz otherwise I'm gonna keep that room all to myself! And you'll never use your precious archive again! Muaaah hahahaha!
